purchase_entry_direct.description: Standalone purchase entry that should create supplier invoice, stock, and GRN records.
invariants: One supplier invoice header is created for the submitted invoice number.
Exactly one positive supplier_outstanding row exists for the supplier invoice document.
Invoice item count matches the submitted purchase lines.
A GRN is auto-created and linked back to the supplier invoice.
Inventory movements are created with movement_direction=in.
Batch and location-wise stock increase by the received quantity.

purchase_order_commitment.description: Purchase order creation should create commitment records without changing stock.
invariants: Purchase order header and items are created.
No inventory batches are created by PO creation alone.
No inventory movements are created by PO creation alone.

purchase_receipt_from_po.description: Recording receipt against an existing PO should update both procurement and stock tables.
invariants: The receipt creates a supplier invoice and GRN.
Exactly one positive supplier_outstanding row exists for the received supplier invoice.
The linked PO received quantities increase.
The linked PO status transitions to partial or completed based on remaining quantity.
Inventory increases only for the received quantity.

sales_invoice_create.description: Creating a sales invoice should write order, invoice, item, stock, movement, and outstanding rows.
invariants: Invoice final_amount matches the order final_amount.
Invoice credit_amount equals final_amount minus paid_amount.
Exactly one customer_outstanding row exists for the invoice document.
Order status becomes invoiced for posted invoices.
Invoice item totals reconcile to invoice taxable and tax totals.
Batch and location-wise stock decrement by sold quantity.
Inventory movements are created with movement_direction=out.
Customer outstanding original_amount matches invoice final_amount.

sales_return_restock.description: A sales return with restock should restore batch stock and produce financial return artifacts.
invariants: Sales return header and items are created.
Batch quantity_available increases for restocked items.
Inventory movement uses reference_type=SALES_RETURN and movement_direction=in.
Location-wise stock increases for restocked items.
Credit note and customer outstanding adjustments are created or updated.

purchase_return_create_cancel.description: A purchase return should reduce stock, create debit-note liabilities, and fully reverse those effects on cancel.
invariants: Purchase return totals reconcile from item value and GST.
Supplier invoice item and GRN item quantity_returned increment on create and reverse on cancel.
Batch and location-wise stock decrease for return-to-supplier items and restore on cancel.
A debit note and negative supplier outstanding row are created.
Cancelling the return voids debit note and supplier outstanding state.

payment_receipt.description: Recording a payment should update payment, allocation, invoice, and outstanding ledgers.
invariants: A payment record is created.
An allocation links the payment to the invoice.
Invoice paid_amount equals the active allocation sum for that invoice.
Invoice paid_amount and credit_amount change consistently.
Customer outstanding outstanding_amount matches invoice credit_amount after allocation.
The invoice still has exactly one outstanding row after allocation.

stock_receive.description: Receiving stock should increment the batch, location-wise stock, and create a movement audit row.
invariants: Movement type is receive with movement_direction=in.
Batch quantity_available increases by the received quantity.
Location-wise stock increases by the received quantity.

stock_issue.description: Issuing stock should decrement the batch, location-wise stock, and create a movement audit row.
invariants: Movement type is issue with movement_direction=out.
Batch quantity_available decreases by the issued quantity.
Location-wise stock decreases by the issued quantity.

stock_transfer.description: Stock transfer should move quantity between locations with a balanced transfer movement pair.
invariants: Two movement rows are created: transfer_out and transfer_in.
Source location-wise stock decreases by the transfer quantity.
Destination location-wise stock increases by the transfer quantity.
Batch quantity_available remains net unchanged.

stock_adjustment.description: Stock adjustment should change batch and location-wise quantities and create a movement audit row.
invariants: Inventory movement exists for the adjustment reason.
Batch quantity_available changes by the adjustment amount.
Location-wise stock changes by the adjustment amount.

stock_writeoff.description: Stock writeoff should reduce stock and create compliance writeoff records.
invariants: Writeoff header and line items are created.
Inventory movement exists with movement_direction=out.
Batch and location-wise stock decrease by the written-off quantity.
GST adjustment is created when ITC reversal applies.

invoice_cancel_reversal.description: Cancelling a posted unpaid invoice before filing deadline should reverse stock effects and close the invoice outstanding row.
invariants: Invoice status becomes cancelled.
Invoice inventory movements are removed after reversal.
Batch and location-wise stock restore to pre-invoice levels.
The invoice outstanding row remains singular and becomes cancelled with zero balance.

inventory_read_contracts.description: High-risk inventory read paths used by the frontend dashboard and stock pages.
invariants: Overview, current stock, valuation, and dashboard endpoints return HTTP 200 for the test tenant.
Category filters that pass textual values do not crash the query layer.

grn_read_contracts.description: High-risk GRN read paths used by the purchase module.
invariants: GRN number generation returns HTTP 200.
GRN listing and detail endpoints resolve within the tenant context without 500s.
